english.title: Drive beyond the required period for rest / refreshment - domestic

(A)_[a vehicle,]_
(B)_[vehicles,]_

namely **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..), to which section 96(1) of the Transport Act 1968 applied and having been on duty during the working day for

(C)_[a period of]_
(D)_[periods amounting in the aggregate to]_

(E)_[during that period]_
